title: Golden Milk (Haldi Doodh)

seo.title: Golden Milk (Haldi Doodh) - Ayurvedic Recipe for Immunity and Inflammation
seo.description: Learn how to make Golden Milk (Haldi Doodh), a traditional Ayurvedic turmeric latte used to support immunity, reduce inflammation, and improve sleep.

purpose: To reduce systemic inflammation, support respiratory health, and promote restful sleep.
target_condition: General immunity, joint pain, and common cold
traditional_context: Haldi Doodh is a staple in Indian households, used as a comforting tonic to treat everything from the common cold to internal injuries. In Ayurveda, the combination of turmeric (Haridra) and warm milk creates a soothing, anti-inflammatory elixir that balances Vata and Kapha.

ingredients_list.notes: Use high-quality organic turmeric powder or fresh grated root
Cow's milk or a plant-based alternative like almond or coconut milk
Crucial for enhancing the absorption of curcumin
Optional; add only after the milk has cooled slightly to avoid heating the honey
Optional; adds lubrication and helps in absorption

preparation.step: Pour the milk into a small saucepan and heat over medium heat.
Whisk in the turmeric powder, black pepper, and ghee.
Simmer gently for 5-10 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent scorching.
Remove from heat and pour into a cup.
Once the milk is warm (not boiling), stir in honey if using.

precautions.precaution: Do not boil honey, as it is considered 'ama' (toxic) in Ayurveda when overheated.
Ensure black pepper is included to maximize the bioavailability of the turmeric.

who_should_avoid.warning: Individuals with gallstones should consult a practitioner before increasing turmeric intake.
People on blood-thinning medications should use caution due to turmeric's mild anticoagulant properties.
